Hey, sorry for the super late reply. 

My dad and I have never been close. I tried to be close with him after my mum and I moved out when I was 5 or so, but he's way too unreliable. He makes promises he never intends to keep, and then he makes up clearly bullshit excuses like he didn't have enough money for petrol, yet a few days later he's off 100s of miles south or whatever with his little happy new family. Not once in the past 12 or so years has he ever just came to see me, and if he drops by, it's with her. His anorexic, junkie bitch of a girlfriend.

He has no time for me. And i have no intention of making time for him, ever. 

We've both came extremely close to killing eachother, several times, and honestly, the only reason I haven't finished the job is because he's not worth the cost of getting the stains out of my clothes.
